name: Diablo IV: Season of Hell's Legacy
summary: Season of Hell’s Legacy is live in Diablo IV. Step into Waking Nightmares that bring some of the most infamous moments from Diablo’s past into the present. Guided by the lost soul of Deckard Cain, confront echoes of legendary foes, explore familiar locations reimagined in Diablo IV, and contain the fearsome powers of the Prime Evils.
